boundaries: face kern for FIXED fonts verified linear in px (r5b: worst 0.0006px at 16/32/50 vs v*px/100 on Arial/Times/Baskerville B/Z) — only @100 tables stored
zero-kern families stay zero in every face (r6pre: 9 fonts x 30 strong pairs all zero under bold)
near-R faces (ascii row identical to R, ext-fallback-only diffs) inherit the R kern table
w200 ascii rows equal w300 for all but 2 fonts (Hiragino Sans, Avenir Next); w100 is its own table in 53 fonts — both swept where ascii differs
su face band overrides stored SPARSE (only deviating pair/size); fractional sizes 6..23 use the kk model between stored anchors — same exposure class as k98 R (verified clean at 22.5/23.5 there)
su VARIABLE WEIGHT kern (w100..w900 numeric weights of system-ui) deferred to 刀100; su face kern here covers keyword faces B/I/Z/M/S only
face triples (3-char kern chains under faces) not captured — R triples apply as approximation (挂账 刀100)
sc x face combos (small-caps bold, small-caps italic beyond the swallowed-italic rule) partially covered: S swept per font; composite sc+bold separate table only where res says S != B+s (挂账 刀100)

_meta.model: ctx.font face axis (刀99): style/variant/weight tokens before size resolve to per-font FACE advance tables; faces are pure lookup (no synthesis rules); fonts without a bold face share one DEFBOLD table (PingFang SC Semibold); small-caps is a real substitution table whose kern is NOT the R kern; system-ui faces are variable-font instances: per-face optical ladders + per-face kern knots and sparse GPOS band overrides; the shared DEFBOLD table is the LAST entry of tables (captured as bold "PingFang SC")
_meta.sources: probe chrome 145.0.7632.117 (CFT) via tools/webplatform/capture/probe_run.py; captures k99-r1/r1b/r2/r2c (tables+res), k99-r3 (su ladders), k99-r4 (sc spots), k99-r5 (vert), k99-r6a/r6a2 (face ascii kern), k99-r6b/r6b2 (face ext kern), k99-r6d (su face knots+bands)
_meta.units: tables/scspot/suFaces rows = px at the given size (adv tables are px@100); vertF raw anchor ints at the given px; kernFaces pair values = px@100 floats; suKern kk = 1e-4 em ints at 16/20/24, v100 = px@100 x100 int (k98 convention), kb = px*100 int at integer sizes 6..23 (sparse: only |band - kkmodel| > 0.05px stored)
